relocation_line: I will relocate to Sydney for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi Ferrycarrig team,

I'm Marc. I finished my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I earned a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019. Your graduate role is out on a major civil project in Sydney, working day to day with the site supervisors, so I'm applying.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I was on site in the Philippines, first on a community hall renovation and then on subdivision finishing works. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, did inspections and quality checks, and tracked procurement and materials.

I'm happy to move to Sydney and can start two weeks after an offer. I hold a White Card, and I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). I'd be glad to talk any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
